title: Geno define presentation
description: Optional fighter-entry presentation (geno >= 9). Package art wins, then a retail base or explicit define.template. Lookup does not change gameplay or online identity.

icon.description: Select tile and card face; 64x56 retail aspect, dimensions 1..1024.

anyOf.description: Plain .gxtex basename in mod files/; no paths, spaces or ..; pc/tools/png2gx.py --allow-odd-size.

items.description: Plain .gxtex basename in mod files/; no paths, spaces or ..; pc/tools/png2gx.py --allow-odd-size.

portrait.description: Select CSP; 136x188 retail aspect. One file or 1..255 costume files; an out-of-list costume uses entry zero.
portrait.x-engine-default: retail base/explicit template disc art, otherwise letters

anyOf.description: Plain .gxtex basename in mod files/; no paths, spaces or ..; pc/tools/png2gx.py --allow-odd-size.

items.description: Plain .gxtex basename in mod files/; no paths, spaces or ..; pc/tools/png2gx.py --allow-odd-size.

stock.description: HUD and results stock icon; 24x24 retail aspect. Use RGB5A3 or RGBA8; no palette.
stock.x-engine-default: retail base/explicit template disc art, otherwise letters

emblem.description: Results emblem behind rank; one file without a palette.

anyOf.description: Plain .gxtex basename in mod files/; no paths, spaces or ..; pc/tools/png2gx.py --allow-odd-size.

items.description: Plain .gxtex basename in mod files/; no paths, spaces or ..; pc/tools/png2gx.py --allow-odd-size.

results.description: Results card picture; 52x74 retail aspect. One file or 1..255 costume files; use RGB5A3 or RGBA8, no palette. Missing/unusable falls back to portrait, then retail, then initials.
results.x-engine-default: portrait, then retail base/explicit template disc art, then letters
